dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS v3.02+) by Vincent Bryan Coen. Uses >>source free directive and GnuCOBOL-style *> comments.

purpose.domain_detail: Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) - nominal ledger unload utility that backs up an ISAM nominal ledger file to a sequential .seq file
purpose.summary: This program reads all records from an ISAM-organized nominal ledger file (irsnominal) and writes them sequentially to a backup file named irsacnts.seq. It is part of the ACAS accounting system and acts as a companion to a corresponding restore program. Output logging is handled via a called module ACAS-Sysout.

notable_features: Dynamic/indexed file access with status checking
COPY statements for environment, FD, and working-storage sections (envdiv.cob, irsfdwsnl.cob, irswsnl.cob, wsfnctn.cob, wsnames.cob, wscall.cob, Test-Data-Flags.cob, Proc-Get-Env-Set-Files.cob)
CALL to external ACAS-Sysout logging module
GNU GPL licensed source with copyright notice embedded in comments
High comment ratio (52%) with detailed documentation
verdict.notes: This is clearly a production component of the ACAS accounting system. The high comment ratio is due to extensive copyright/license text embedded as comments. The program references ACAS v3.02 and is dated 2023, suggesting active maintenance of a long-running system (copyright 1976-2024).
